vault_asset_balance.meaning: asset balance held by the WERC7575Vault contract at the time unregisterVault is called

unsupported_balance_present.meaning: the vault holds a nonzero asset balance that has no corresponding shares (e.g. the directly sent 1 wei)

unregister_completed.meaning: unregisterVault successfully sunsets the vault instead of being denied

unregister_denied.meaning: unregisterVault is denied (DoS) so the asset vault cannot be sunset

assumptions: An actor can transfer asset directly to the vault contract without going through the share minting path (ass_attacker_can_send_directly).
The 1 wei direct send is treated as a possible trigger rather than an observed event.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify whether the DoS manifests as a revert or a silent failure, so the denial observable is only a Boolean outcome.
Report does not establish the vault's asset balance state before the direct send.

limitations: Only the DoS impact i_dos_unregister is formalized; i_vault_slot_exhaustion, i_unsupported_wei_stuck and i_upgradeable_counterpart are deferred to future claims.
The MAX_VAULTS_PER_SHARE_TOKEN cap of 10 is not part of this single relation and is deferred.
The 1:1 USDC-to-WUSD rate is not needed for this progress relation and is deferred.
Caller authorization for unregisterVault is not stated in the report and is not encoded.
